title: Disclosure of Total Expense Ratio by Asset Management Companies
content:
FICTIONAL DEMO CIRCULAR — NOT AN ACTUAL SEBI PUBLICATION.

To,
All Mutual Funds / Asset Management Companies / Trustee Companies.

Sub: Disclosure of Total Expense Ratio by Asset Management Companies

1. Asset management companies shall disclose the total expense ratio of each scheme on a daily basis on their websites and on the website of the Association of Mutual Funds in India, in the format prescribed in the Annexure.

2. Any change in the base total expense ratio shall be communicated to unit holders at least three working days in advance by email or SMS.

3. This circular applies to all mutual funds and asset management companies and comes into effect on November 1, 2026.

4. Issued for demonstration purposes only.
